narr: Increases in moisture and instability on this day supported thunderstorm development over and near the mountains, and also around the I-25 and Highway 50 corridors. Stronger development did occur across Pueblo county, where heavy rainfall with flash flooding and damaging winds were observed.
ev: Exit 108 was flooded with at least 1.5 feet of water under the overpass.
Widespread flooding was observed in the area, with 5.52 inches of observed rainfall.
Platteville Blvd. was flooded and closed between Painted Hill and Bronco Lanes.
There was a report of one house flooded and multiple houses being sandbagged near Willow Creek in the Baca Grande region of Crestone, Colorado.
